notes.title: sound effects
notes.notes: I have fixed the sound effects so they now play, this will allow me to move the game from a play test to a full release of the game.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Added / Fixed[/h1]

[list]
[*] Keybinds now work and can be set by the player.
[*] Audio sliders are now named correctly and save.
[*] Saving is now in the game and saves settings, score, and highest round.
[*] Arrows now work and replace the visual Keybinds with arrows.
[/list]
